references.title: Physiological heterogeneity in biofilms (stub)
references.author: Stewart, Philip S. and Franklin, Michael J.
references.note: Stub key, cited by the source paper's development discussion. Used by development-and-evolution-spatial for the DEVELOPMENT half: as a colony grows on a shared depleting nutrient field, interior cells sit in a depleted core while outer cells are fed from the rim, so each cell's individual interface becomes embedded in a COLLECTIVE interface defined by shared state --- physiological heterogeneity EMERGING from shared-field competition, not an imposed patterning program. The foundational statement is Stewart \& Franklin, "Physiological heterogeneity in biofilms", Nat. Rev. Microbiol. 6(3):199--210.
